note: Adapted from the new-species description of Emerson 1960 (American Museum Novitates No. 1988); the original is in English. The alate section follows the original's 'Imago (king and dealated male)'. The description is based on 2 dealated males (one of them the type king) and 32 soldiers (including the holotype and paratypes) collected near Keyberg, Elisabethville, Belgian Congo (11°47′ S, 27°25′ E), on 23 and 24 April 1948 (month 4). OCR problem: in Table 2 the column after 'Length of head with mandibles 3.52' and the row 'Thickness of head, including postmentum' are badly garbled (e.g. 'Jno —ase', '£35 Nees ts mites FA'), so the ranges for those two items have not been entered; the other figures are legible.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: King and dealated male: the ventral parts of the head, thorax and abdomen yellowish brown, contrasting with the glossy dark brown of the top of the head and the pronotum. Fontanelle concolorous with the head. Postclypeus slightly paler than the head, with a dark median line. Pronotum with a fine pale longitudinal line in the middle. Sternites 2—5 yellowish brown in the anterior middle; sternites 6—9 mainly dark brown. Ocelli about their own length from the eyes. Antennae broken, segment 2 longer than segment 3, segment 3 longer than segment 4 and about as long as segment 5. Mandibles like those of the worker, but the angle between the apical tooth and the first marginal tooth of the left mandible is less than a right angle and sharper than in the worker, and the angle between the apical tooth and the first marginal tooth of the right mandible is also distinctly less than a right angle. Other characters as in the genus. Measurements (mm, type king/paratype dealated male): head width 1.33/1.44; diameter of the eye 0.36/0.38; lower margin of the eye to the lower margin of the head 0.10/0.09; ocellus length 0.15/0.14; ocellus to eye 0.15/0.14; postclypeus length 0.37/0.35; postclypeus width 0.71/0.71; pronotum length 0.88/0.94; pronotum width 1.45/1.47; hind tibia length 1.41/1.56.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head pale yellowish brown. Outer side of the mandibles dark, the base concolorous with the adjacent head. Pronotum and tergites paler than the head. Head without distinct ridges; a rounded swelling on each side below and behind the antennal base. In the 14-segmented antenna, segment 2 slightly shorter than segment 1 and about half its width, segment 3 as long as segment 2; in the 15-segmented antenna the proportions of segments 1 and 2 are the same, but segment 3 is far shorter than segment 2. Other characters as in the genus. Measurements (mm, holotype/range over four colonies): head length (with mandibles, holotype) 3.52; head length (to the lateral base of the mandibles) 1.86/1.91—2.03; head width 1.59/1.56—1.79; maximum postmentum width 0.48/0.47—0.51; minimum postmentum width 0.39/0.34—0.41; apical width of the labrum 0.45/0.43—0.47; left mandible length 1.80/1.82—1.88; pronotum length 0.47/0.44—0.47; pronotum width 0.88/0.82—0.91; hind tibia length 1.25/1.23—1.36.
